title: Medical Assistance Application Terms: Signers, Retroactive Months, Look-Back and Transfer Penalties
content:
The settings below apply alike on all six tiers of Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage (Standard Patient Pay, Community Spouse Allowance, Dependent Family Allowance, VA Reduced Pension, Home Maintenance Allowance, and Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board).

| Setting | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Who may sign the application | the resident, an agent under power of attorney, or a court-appointed guardian |
| Center may act as the applicant's authorized representative once the resident signs the designation | yes |
| Who may withdraw an application in preparation | the resident or legal representative |
| Retroactive months (months before the application month for which eligibility may be granted if the resident was eligible then) | 3 |
| Day of the month on which nursing facility eligibility begins | the first day of the month |
| Look-back period reviewed for transfers of assets for less than fair market value | 60 months before the application date (the federal 60-month look-back) |
| Resident owes the private rate for days inside a transfer-of-assets penalty period | yes |
| When a transfer penalty period starts | the date the resident is otherwise eligible for institutional care |
| Date on which spousal resources are counted | the start of the first continuous period of institutionalization |

**Points of reading.**

- Eligibility always begins on the first day of a month; a requested eligibility date therefore names the first day of a month.
- The retroactive allowance is 3 months: the earliest month that can be requested is the month that falls 3 months before the application month.
- The look-back runs 60 months back from the application date, not from the requested eligibility date.
- Days inside a transfer penalty period are owed at the private rate; the penalty period begins on the date the resident would otherwise be eligible for institutional care.
- The center may sign as authorized representative only once the resident has signed the designation; the center may never withdraw an application in preparation, which only the resident or legal representative may do.
